Its mode of action has remained unknown through its seven decades of clinical use. Inappropriate prescription of loop diuretics for calcium channel blocker-related peripheral edema: Lessons from physiology. Calcium Channel Blockers (CCB) are commonly used antihypertensive agents, with peripheral edema being a common side effect, reported in up to 70 % of cases. A common pitfall among physicians is that they consider this fluid overload, with some prescribing loop diuretics.
